Her solid foundation in JavaScript and CSS has allowed her to develop a strong command of modern web development technologies including React, NextJS, and TailwindCSS. Roza has taken the lead on front-end tasks, as well as designing, building, and implementing a user-friendly content management system in Sanity. Along with her technical prowess, Roza exhibits exceptional communication skills, providing consistent updates and she is never afraid to ask clarifying questions to ensure her work aligns perfectly with project goals. Roza would be an asset to any team and I, without reservation, would recommend her for any full-stack development role!
